title: HtmlA
responsibility: Renders the native a element without extra wrapper DOM or feature behavior.

inputs.name: HtmlA.attributes
inputs.description: Native a attributes and event handlers. The native atom call preserves Svelte bindings, actions and scoped styles.

inputs.name: HtmlA.children
inputs.description: Optional content within the native a element; native HTML content rules still apply.

outputs.name: HtmlA
outputs.description: The actual native a element, with forwarded attributes and content and no additional wrapper.
